$comment: Completion bar for #121: Delete and rename no longer hidden behind Edit. NotePeek shows Delete in view mode (header) and the title is inline-editable (Save appears when dirty, not only in edit mode). The notes rail gains a per-item delete icon (onDeleteItem → useNotes.deleteItemById with confirm). Rename = inline title editing; body/summary/status/kind stay read-only until Edit.

criteria.target: grep -q "onDeleteItem" src/features/NotesRail.tsx && grep -q "deleteItemById" src/hooks/useNotes.ts && grep -q "peekEditing || dirty" src/features/NotePeek.tsx
